tools.name: aegis_snapshot
tools.description: Read the current UI: the shell (app, route, theme, viewport), every surface on the page with its projected entities and fields and the ids of the actions bound to it, and the selection.

tools.name: aegis_inspect
tools.description: Noun-first discovery: returns the target plus the actions bound to it. Fails with not_found when the target is not on the page.

ref.description: A ref from aegis_snapshot or aegis_search: { kind: "surface", surfaceId } | { kind: "entity", entityId, surfaceId? } | { kind: "action", actionId } | { kind: "route", appId, pathname }.

tools.name: aegis_search
tools.description: Free-text search across the snapshot and the search providers the page registered. Returns ranked refs in `results`; `failedProviders` names providers that failed, whose hits are missing.

tools.name: aegis_invoke
tools.description: The only write entry: runs a registered action by id, with optional params, as the agent. With dryRun: true nothing runs; it returns the action, the params and the action's own preview when it has one. Fails with unavailable for actions only the user may invoke (invocableBy: "user") and with needs_confirm for actions marked confirm.danger: the user has to run those, so point at the control with aegis_highlight. An action that fails comes back as a tool error.

tools.name: aegis_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a path inside the console, such as /portal/datasets. `to` is a path like shell.route.pathname in the snapshot, and a relative path resolves from the current route as a URL path does (x from /gallery goes to /x). Prefer paths: a full URL must be on the origin of the page and fails with invalid_params when the base path of the app is unknown, as does a URL on another origin or a javascript:, data: or blob: URL. Sugar for aegis_invoke("aegis.navigate", { to }).

tools.name: aegis_highlight
tools.description: Scroll a surface, entity or action into view and ring it briefly, to point the user at it. Returns found: false when it is not on the page.

ref.description: A ref from aegis_snapshot or aegis_search: { kind: "surface", surfaceId } | { kind: "entity", entityId, surfaceId? } | { kind: "action", actionId } | { kind: "route", appId, pathname }.

tools.name: aegis_wait_for
tools.description: Wait until a condition holds, then return the snapshot; fails with timeout otherwise. Conditions: present / absent (ref is a surface, entity or action ref), route (the shell pathname equals pathname), text (text appears, case-insensitively, in a surface label, entity or field; only in surfaceId when given), field (field name on surface surfaceId equals value).

condition.description: { kind: "present" | "absent", ref } | { kind: "route", pathname } | { kind: "text", text, surfaceId? } | { kind: "field", surfaceId, name, value }.

ref.description: A ref from aegis_snapshot or aegis_search: { kind: "surface", surfaceId } | { kind: "entity", entityId, surfaceId? } | { kind: "action", actionId } | { kind: "route", appId, pathname }.

timeoutMs.description: Defaults to 5000; longer waits are cut to 20000.
